title: striped_bass_passage_and_calls_hourly
description: One row of public.striped_bass_passage_and_calls_hourly. Joins striped bass rows of fish_passage_hourly to detection_counts_hourly on node_id and UTC hour. fish_count is sonar tracks and is per direction. splash_detections is the hour total of hydrophone events labeled bass_spawning_splash. striped_bass_detections is the hour total of detections with species_id striped_bass. Those two detection totals repeat on every direction row for the hour; do not sum them across directions. A hydrophone-only hour has null direction and null fish_count. A sonar-only hour has zero detection totals.
